title: SURE Harness Event
description: A normalized harness event, as an adapter sends it to SURE. The Rust form is sure_protocol::event::EventEnvelope. See docs/architecture/EVENT_PROTOCOL.md.

capability_tier.description: 0 snapshot, 1 observed, 2 protected. Absent means the adapter did not say, which is not the same as 0.

session_id.description: The harness's own session identifier. Not a SURE SessionId.
